thread:
incidents-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and p95 token latency from inference pool in us-west-3b. Backend ASG showing instance network retransmits and gRPC 504s. Notifying oncall.

maria (oncall): ack. paging in sam and anna. Starting triage.

sam (sre): on it. Can someone confirm if this is request-level or infra-level? I see GRPC_CONNECT errors in proxy logs.

anna (infra): AWS metrics show increased ENI RX errors and a spike in instance network errors for the us-west-3b AZ (Subnet: 10.40.0.0/20). No node terminations reported.

maria (oncall): customer-facing impact? kevin, any CS alerts?

kevin (cs): two mid-market customers reported 20-40% request failures since ~12:10 UTC. We have support tickets open. ETA for update needed in 15m.

sam (sre): quick mitigation plan: 1) shift 30% traffic off us-west-3b -> us-west-2 weight change 2) disable streaming on heavy clients to reduce connection churn 3) spin up warm ephemeral nodes in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 for failover.

maria (oncall): +1 to traffic split. Do we have a runbook for ENI noise? Anna, can you check for AWS-side issue and open a case?

anna (infra): opening AWS support case. Case: 12345678901. Also triggering control-plane reroute: updating route policy to prefer us-west-2 for inference-route map.

sam (sre): running the routing change now. Command:

```json
# update route weight
routectl set-weight inference-usw3b 0.7
routectl set-weight inference-usw2 0.3
```

sam (sre): observed: proxy pool connections dropping during weight flip, rolling back to 0.85/0.15 to reduce thrash.

maria (oncall): noted. Start draining the most-affected instances in us-west-3b to avoid connection resets.

sam (sre): drain commands issued to three instances (i-0a1b2c3d, i-0e4f5g6h, i-0i7j8k9l). Also enabling circuit breaker for top-traffic routes:

```yaml
circuit_breaker:
  max_retries: 2
  backoff_ms: 200
```

kevin (cs): messaging to impacted customers: short notice acknowledging increased errors, mitigation underway, ETA 30-60m. Will send now.

deploy-bot: Rollout 2026.3.12-inference-cache-regen aborted due to elevated 5xx rates (auto-abort threshold exceeded).

sam (sre): looking at model servers — KV cache population stalled on a subset of nodes. KVCACHE hit rate dropped 70% -> increased CPU for re-population. Likely exacerbating latency.

maria (oncall): good catch. Can we temporarily route requests from heavy KV-dependant flows to model-variant L1 (lower-kv)?

sam (sre): yes. Adding model variant fallback for those routes. Patch applied: traffic for /v1/generate with tag heavy_kv -> model-variant:v1-l1.

anna (infra): AWS replied on the case: "We see elevated NIC-level retransmit rate in the AZ. Our network team is investigating a fabric-side scheduler bump." No ETA yet.

maria (oncall): next steps checklist:
- continue gradual traffic shift off us-west-3b
- keep draining affected instances
- monitor p95 and error-rate, update customers in 30m
- escalate to infra lead if no improvement in 45m

kevin (cs): update sent to customers. One wants SLA credit assessment — collecting logs.

sam (sre): metrics: p95 token latency from 380ms -> 1.2s at peak; 5xx rate from 0.6% -> 6.5% across the AZ. After weight adjust it's down to ~2.1%.

maria (oncall): thanks. If AWS updates, post here. I'll keep the page open and will hand off at next shift if still active.

anna (infra): AWS: "Mitigation in-flight: traffic steering on fabric. Expect partial improvement in 10-20 minutes." Posting AWS case update.

sam (sre): seeing slow recovery: p95 trending downward. continuing to keep traffic partially diverted and not reintroduce streaming.

kevin (cs): customers acknowledged. One asked for hourly updates; will do.

maria (oncall): good work team. Leaving monitoring and escalation with sam and anna. Handoff to night oncall in 40m if still active. Closing the thread for now but will append updates here.

sam (sre): standing by. Will post final resolution when AWS confirms fix and all instances healthy."
